name: growthub-inference-certification-deps
description: Deterministic, scoped dependency set for the governed inference certification suites. The workspace kit's schema boundary (apps/workspace/lib/adapters/inference/contracts.js) resolves the real AJV validator lazily; exported workspaces install it from apps/workspace/package.json, and this manifest provisions the exact same validator for repo-level certification runs (local + CI) without installing the full workspace application graph or touching pnpm-lock.yaml. Provisioned exclusively via `npm ci --ignore-scripts` by scripts/run-inference-certification.mjs.
